record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Speak<WH01696><WTH8761> unto all the congregation<WH05712> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, and say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto them, Ye shall be holy<WH06918>: for I the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430> <FI>am<Fi> holy<WH06918>.
Ye shall fear<WH03372><WTH8799> every man<WH0376> his mother<WH0517>, and his father<WH01>, and keep<WH08104><WTH8799> my sabbaths<WH07676>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>.
Turn<WH06437><WTH8799> ye not unto idols<WH0457>, nor make<WH06213><WTH8799> to yourselves molten<WH04541> gods<WH0430>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>.
And if ye offer<WH02076><WTH8799> a sacrifice<WH02077> of peace offerings<WH08002> unto the LORD<WH03068>, ye shall offer<WH02076><WTH8799> it at your own will<WH07522>.

It shall be eaten<WH0398><WTH8735> the same day<WH03117> ye offer<WH02077> it, and on the morrow<WH04283>: and if ought remain<WH03498><WTH8737> until the third<WH07992> day<WH03117>, it shall be burnt<WH08313><WTH8735> in the fire<WH0784>.
And if it be eaten<WH0398><WTH8735> at all<WH0398><WTH8736> on the third<WH07992> day<WH03117>, it <FI>is<Fi> abominable<WH06292>; it shall not be accepted<WH07521><WTH8735>.

Therefore <FI>every one<Fi> that eateth<WH0398><WTH8802> it shall bear<WH05375><WTH8799> his iniquity<WH05771>, because he hath profaned<WH02490><WTH8765> the hallowed thing<WH06944> of the LORD<WH03068>: and that soul<WH05315> shall be cut off<WH03772><WTH8738> from among his people<WH05971>.

And when ye reap<WH07114><WTH8800> the harvest<WH07105> of your land<WH0776>, thou shalt not wholly reap<WH03615><WTH8762> the corners<WH06285> of thy field<WH07704>, neither shalt thou gather<WH03950><WTH8762> the gleanings<WH03951> of thy harvest<WH07105>.

And thou shalt not glean<WH05953><WTH8779> thy vineyard<WH03754>, neither shalt thou gather<WH03950><WTH8762> <FI>every<Fi> grape<WH06528> of thy vineyard<WH03754>; thou shalt leave<WH05800><WTH8799> them for the poor<WH06041> and stranger<WH01616>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>.<CM>
Ye shall not steal<WH01589><WTH8799>, neither deal falsely<WH03584><WTH8762>, neither lie<WH08266><WTH8762> one<WH0376> to another<WH05997>.
And ye shall not swear<WH07650><WTH8735> by my name<WH08034> falsely<WH08267>, neither shalt thou profane<WH02490><WTH8765> the name<WH08034> of thy God<WH0430>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.

Thou shalt not defraud<WH06231><WTH8799> thy neighbour<WH07453>, neither rob<WH01497><WTH8799> <FI>him<Fi> : the wages<WH06468> of him that is hired<WH07916> shall not abide<WH03885><WTH8799> with thee all night until the morning<WH01242>.

Thou shalt not curse<WH07043><WTH8762> the deaf<WH02795>, nor put<WH05414><WTH8799> a stumblingblock<WH04383> before<WH06440> the blind<WH05787>, but shalt fear<WH03372><WTH8804> thy God<WH0430>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.

Ye shall do<WH06213><WTH8799> no unrighteousness<WH05766> in judgment<WH04941>: thou shalt not respect<WH05375><WTH8799> the person<WH06440> of the poor<WH01800>, nor honour<WH01921><WTH8799> the person<WH06440> of the mighty<WH01419>: <FI>but<Fi> in righteousness<WH06664> shalt thou judge<WH08199><WTH8799> thy neighbour<WH05997>.

Thou shalt not go<WH03212><WTH8799> up and down <FI>as<Fi> a talebearer<WH07400> among thy people<WH05971>: neither shalt thou stand<WH05975><WTH8799> against the blood<WH01818> of thy neighbour<WH07453>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.

Thou shalt not hate<WH08130><WTH8799> thy brother<WH0251> in thine heart<WH03824>: thou shalt in any wise<WH03198><WTH8687> rebuke<WH03198><WTH8686> thy neighbour<WH05997>, and not suffer<WH05375><WTH8799> sin<WH02399> upon him. <RF>and...: or, that thou bear not sin for him<Rf>

Thou shalt not avenge<WH05358><WTH8799>, nor bear any grudge<WH05201><WTH8799> against the children<WH01121> of thy people<WH05971>, but thou shalt love<WH0157><WTH8804> thy neighbour<WH07453> as thyself<WH03644>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>

Ye shall keep<WH08104><WTH8799> my statutes<WH02708>. Thou shalt not let thy cattle<WH0929> gender<WH07250><WTH8686> with a diverse kind<WH03610>: thou shalt not sow<WH02232><WTH8799> thy field<WH07704> with mingled seed<WH03610>: neither shall a garment<WH0899> mingled<WH03610> of linen and woollen<WH08162> come<WH05927><WTH8799> upon thee.

And whosoever<WH0376> lieth<WH07901><WTH8799> carnally<WH02233><WH07902> with a woman<WH0802>, that <FI>is<Fi> a bondmaid<WH08198>, betrothed<WH02778><WTH8737> to an husband<WH0376>, and not at all<WH06299><WTH8715> redeemed<WH06299><WTH8738>, nor freedom<WH02668> given<WH05414><WTH8738> her; she shall be scourged<WH01244>; they shall not be put to death<WH04191><WTH8714>, because she was not free<WH02666><WTH8795>. <RF>betrothed...: or, abused by any: Heb. reproached by (or, for) man<Rf> <RF>she shall...: or, they, etc: Heb. there shall be a scourging<Rf>

And he shall bring<WH0935><WTH8689> his trespass offering<WH0817> unto the LORD<WH03068>, unto the door<WH06607> of the tabernacle<WH0168> of the congregation<WH04150>, <FI>even<Fi> a ram<WH0352> for a trespass offering<WH0817>.

And the priest<WH03548> shall make an atonement<WH03722><WTH8765> for him with the ram<WH0352> of the trespass offering<WH0817> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068> for his sin<WH02403> which he hath done<WH02398><WTH8804>: and the sin<WH02403> which he hath done<WH02398><WTH8804> shall be forgiven<WH05545><WTH8738> him.

And when ye shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> into the land<WH0776>, and shall have planted<WH05193><WTH8804> all manner of trees<WH06086> for food<WH03978>, then ye shall count<WH06188><WH00> the fruit<WH06529> thereof as uncircumcised<WH06188><WTH8804><WH06190>: three<WH07969> years<WH08141> shall it be as uncircumcised<WH06189> unto you: it shall not be eaten<WH0398><WTH8735> of.

But in the fourth<WH07243> year<WH08141> all the fruit<WH06529> thereof shall be holy<WH06944> to praise<WH01974> the LORD<WH03068> <FI>withal<Fi> . <RF>holy...: Heb. holiness of praises to the LORD<Rf>

And in the fifth<WH02549> year<WH08141> shall ye eat<WH0398><WTH8799> of the fruit<WH06529> thereof, that it may yield<WH03254><WTH8687> unto you the increase<WH08393> thereof: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>.
Ye shall not eat<WH0398><WTH8799> <FI>any thing<Fi> with the blood<WH01818>: neither shall ye use enchantment<WH05172><WTH8762>, nor observe times<WH06049><WTH8779>.
Ye shall not round<WH05362><WTH8686> the corners<WH06285> of your heads<WH07218>, neither shalt thou mar<WH07843><WTH8686> the corners<WH06285> of thy beard<WH02206>.

Ye shall not make<WH05414><WTH8799> any<WH03793> cuttings<WH08296> in your flesh<WH01320> for the dead<WH05315>, nor print<WH05414><WTH8799> any marks<WH07085> upon you: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.

Do not prostitute<WH02490><WTH8762> thy daughter<WH01323>, to cause her to be a whore<WH02181><WTH8687>; lest the land<WH0776> fall to whoredom<WH02181><WTH8799>, and the land<WH0776> become full<WH04390><WTH8804> of wickedness<WH02154>. <RF>prostitute: Heb. profane<Rf><CM>
Ye shall keep<WH08104><WTH8799> my sabbaths<WH07676>, and reverence<WH03372><WTH8799> my sanctuary<WH04720>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.

Regard<WH06437><WTH8799> not them that have familiar spirits<WH0178>, neither seek<WH01245><WTH8762> after wizards<WH03049>, to be defiled<WH02930><WTH8800> by them: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>.

Thou shalt rise up<WH06965><WTH8799> before<WH06440> the hoary head<WH07872>, and honour<WH01921><WTH8804> the face<WH06440> of the old man<WH02205>, and fear<WH03372><WTH8804> thy God<WH0430>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.
And if a stranger<WH01616> sojourn<WH01481><WTH8799> with thee in your land<WH0776>, ye shall not vex<WH03238><WTH8686> him. <RF>vex: or, oppress<Rf>

<FI> But<Fi> the stranger<WH01616> that dwelleth<WH01481><WTH8802> with you shall be unto you as one born<WH0249> among you, and thou shalt love<WH0157><WTH8804> him as thyself; for ye were strangers<WH01616> in the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>.
Ye shall do<WH06213><WTH8799> no unrighteousness<WH05766> in judgment<WH04941>, in meteyard<WH04060>, in weight<WH04948>, or in measure<WH04884>.

Just<WH06664> balances<WH03976>, just<WH06664> weights<WH068>, a just<WH06664> ephah<WH0374>, and a just<WH06664> hin<WH01969>, shall ye have: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>, which brought you out<WH03318><WTH8689> of the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>. <RF>weights: Heb. stones<Rf>
Therefore shall ye observe<WH08104><WTH8804> all my statutes<WH02708>, and all my judgments<WH04941>, and do<WH06213><WTH8804> them: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>
